description: (0.5.0, Draft) Implementations without RFC-ACDP-0021 support fail closed (RFC-ACDP-0021 §12). Behavioral, registry- and consumer-side.

input.golden: kl-001 (controller did:web:agents.example.com:ci, identity oidc https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com / repo:example/pipeline:ref:refs/heads/main, registry did:web:registry.example.com)

scenarios.name: A — consumer without the profile verifies a keyless body

expected.behavior: RFC-ACDP-0001 §5.11 step 4 finds no verificationMethod for the acdp-kl- fragment. The body MUST NOT be accepted by any other path.

scenarios.name: B — DID document contains a verificationMethod whose fragment begins acdp-kl-

expected.behavior: Refused by keyless-aware registries and consumers on both paths; the prefix is reserved.

scenarios.name: C — 0.4.0 registry receives a publish carrying key_attestation
D — Seam-style consumer pinned to a pre-keyless acdp release

expected.behavior: Resolution fails closed exactly as for an unknown key; no new key-status or revocation-class value reaches it.
